pages: I went down to see him. He is still sitting there. He looks at his hands the way the second one did. I said his name and he said mine, and then he said: I can hear the hill. Can you hear the hill? I could not. I brought him bread, which was stupid. He held it for a long time. He did not eat it. He said: tell my mother I am not cold. I do not know if that was a kindness or a report.
